subject: SkyCraft pilot runway extension + combined credit/discount request
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@skycraft.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@skycraft.com
Date: 2027-12-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Pilot runway extension + supplemental credits for SkyCraft POC

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency and quality on the retrieval flow. We’ve been running the POC for two weeks and are seeing promising results, but we need a little runway to finish integrating our ingestion pipeline and measure end-to-end accuracy.

Two asks from our side:
- Can we extend the POC for an additional 6 weeks (current contract ends 1/5)?
- Would Redwood consider a supplemental credit allotment (we estimate ~150k tokens / week) — ballpark $40k in credits to avoid throttling while we complete ingest?

If we can get the extension + credits and a 20% introductory discount on usage for the first 6 months post-commit, we’re prepared to move to a 12-month committed plan and finalize SOW/legal within 30 days.

I’ve attached our POC metrics snapshot and usage projections (SkyCraft_Eval_Metrics.pdf). Happy to jump on a call if that helps.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Price
Head of AI
SkyCraft Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@skycraft.com>
Date: 2027-12-14T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Pilot runway extension + supplemental credits for SkyCraft POC

Folks — forwarding SkyCraft's ask. TL;DR: 6-week POC extension, ~$40k additional credits, and 20% discount for first 6 months if they sign a 12-month commit within 30 days.

Proposed commercial package I drafted:
- POC extension: +6 weeks (no additional charge)
- Supplemental credits: $45,000 in platform credits applied to trial usage (to cover peak ingestion)
- Introductory discount: 20% off per-token rate for first 6 months following a 12-month committed contract
- Conditions: DocuSign signature of SOW within 30 days; usage credits expire at end of extension window if not consumed.

I’m flagging this for exec clearance because the credit amount exceeds our standard $30k header for SDR-managed pilots. Related HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DL-2027-1147. MA plan attached (MA-Plan-SkyCraft.xlsx) with milestones and success criteria.

Notes on rationale:
- High strategic fit: SkyCraft is a systems integrator in manufacturing with clear references and a likely path to an annualized committed expansion.
- Short term lift in ARR risk looks acceptable given conversion signal and legal timeline.

Requesting: Aditya / Marissa — approval to offer the combined $45k credit + 20% discount under the SOW conditions above. If approved, I’ll instruct Legal to push the SOW and Finance to prepare the credit memo.

Thanks — Karthik

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@skycraft.com>
Date: 2027-12-14T12:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Pilot runway extension + supplemental credits for SkyCraft POC

Appreciate the write-up, Karthik. Quick questions before I greenlight:
1) Conversion signal — what’s the expected ARR if SkyCraft signs the 12-month commit? (rough range is fine)
2) Is there any regulatory / data handling complexity (PII, on-prem requirements) that Legal should be aware of?
3) Confirm probability of signature within 30 days and whether they can accept electronic signing (DocuSign).

If answers are clean, I’m comfortable approving up to $50k in credits + the 20% discount conditional on:
- Legal signoff on the SOW (no open redlines that expose data controls risk)
- DocuSign executed within 30 days
- Finance to create a credit memo tied to DL-2027-1147

Karthik — please populate the expected ARR range in HubSpot and ping Finance to prep the credit entry. Laura — can you review the redlines once Karthik kicks the SOW? Jordan — I cc'd you so you're looped on conditions.

Thanks,
Aditya
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
